## Skill name

Proposed directory/skill name (lowercase, hyphens only):

## What it does

Describe what this skill helps a sales team accomplish. One paragraph max.

## Trigger phrases

When should an AI agent activate this skill? List 3-5 example phrases a user might say.

## Related skills

Which existing skills does this relate to? How does it differ?

- **Differs from [skill]** because...
- **Pairs well with [skill]** for...

## Example output

Provide a short example of what this skill should produce.

## Checklist

- [ ] This doesn't duplicate an existing skill
- [ ] I can describe the skill in under 500 lines
- [ ] The skill is based on real sales workflows, not theory
- [ ] I've identified which phase it belongs to (foundation, prospecting, deal execution, deal close, deal intelligence, sales ops)
